description: MDB: Nested BeginTrans (depth 1 outer, depth 2 inner) with held Edit() on pre-txn dynaset (rsOut) and held AddNew() on outer-level dynaset (rsIn1): depth 1 updates row 1 (V=110); depth 2 updates row 2 (V=220) + inserts row 20, starts rsOut.Edit on row 3 & rsIn1.AddNew (ID=21), then inner Rollback (partial rollback!); inspect EditMode/Update on both buffers and depth-1 rows. Next depth 2 updates row 4 (V=440) + holds rsOut.Edit on row 4 (V=444) across inner CommitTrans -> rsOut.Update -> outer CommitTrans. Keeps ALL pages at every nested boundary so partial rollback vs committed bytes are exact.
